  • Setup › Data Backup, custom backup 24–26 Nov without attachments (made 25 Nov 09:48 UTC) → completed in 20 s, 271 records, restorable = true, no "made before restore was available" reason; expires 2 Dec.
  • Restore into a new sandbox ("QA RT27 restore 2863") → accepted (202). Steps: provisioning → copying_identity (177 s) → copying_metadata (200 s) → finishing (232 s) → Ready after 242 s, no error. On 15 Nov it stopped at copying_metadata for over 32 minutes.

Not checked: Signing in to the sandbox itself (it is entered by picking it at login; an API sign-in to it is refused with 403).

Environment: staging-desk.taviportal.com, tenant NDC-Staging, Microsoft Edge (Chromium) + API; account: ndc-staging-owner (owner)
Method: API + manual browser (rule editor)

Checked:

  • Active On Create rule in QA PA Dept 1, condition Subject starts with "QA RT27 3230".
  • PATCH with only the actions → 200, condition kept, action changed. PATCH with only the name → 200, condition kept.
  • Ticket "Other subject …" → rule not fired; ticket "QA RT27 3230 match" → fired once (control).
  • PATCH with "criteria": null → condition cleared (explicit null still clears).
  • Editor: change only the action and Save → condition kept. Remove the last condition and Save → editor sends criteria: null and the rule reopens with "No conditions — actions run on every event of this trigger" (the part the developer did not check live).

Note: Side note, not part of this ticket: with no conditions the diagram still reads "CONDITION 1".
